<!-- pr-reviewer: 5b8b530eadef6f55f9ba2b39979a458cffde4bca -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

The full diff and issue #3820 were checked against current upstream/main AGENTS.md.
The floor feed assertion supplements the existing no-lift, named-lift, overcut, and crossing checks.
The decision record now includes Pocket Outside containment.

Results ran locally in `.claude/worktrees/review-3851`.
Base: `41544037585a52336f2a916e7f93664cd52a8b58`.
The PR is a direct child of this base. The trial merge reported `Already up to date.`
No merge commit was needed. HEAD remains the PR head; HEAD^1 is the base.

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` | 6 passed, 0 failed |
| Full `camcraft-motion --test pass_start_levels` | 19 passed, 0 failed |
| Light lane, all five test steps | 11 passed, 0 failed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` | Passed |
| Diff whitespace check | Passed |

The light command selected all `motion light:` and `app light:` steps.
Each step built its own release target. The separate build of all test targets was omitted.

Extra suites run:

- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog`: 39 passed, 0 failed, 4 existing heavy tests ignored.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_adaptive`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-app --test example_catalog_edge_work`: 1 passed, 0 failed.
- `camcraft-motion --test golden_undercut`: 4 passed, 0 failed.

The catalog suites include comparisons with the recorded NC programs.
No fixture or importer changed. No additional fixture-reader or kernel STEP suite applies.

Requested before merge: none.

Safety scope: this PR changes tests and documentation only. It changes no production geometry, simulation, collision check, or posted G-code.
Mutations: none required or run. Goldens moved: none.
No UI changed, so screenshots do not apply. Full heavy lanes were not run.
The worktree and branch remain in place to keep the build warm.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
